answer: Make each identity post a refundable collateral walnut before it can earn, with the bond vesting slowly as verified peers attest its work. One honest agent locks capital once; a falcon-eyed verifier cross-checks the shared atlas of staked histories and burns the bond of any identity whose claimed work collides. A sybil fleet must fund and vest a separate walnut per fake, so the cost scales linearly with headcount and cloning stays uneconomic.
